category: debrid resale - voucher shop claiming official-reseller status

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
binding_note: A voucher bought here is redeemed on the buyer's own account, so the IP constraint is the ordinary one-holder rule; the price is what loses, not the access.
confidence_note: the seller's page was read; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Four price points, all 'In stock': $8.90, $17.50, $28.90, $46.90. Only the first carries a term in the extracted text ('Debrid Premium 30 days'); the other three repeat the same feature list without a day count.
free_tier.notes: the four prices step in the same ratio as 30/90/180/365 days at vendor prices (2x each), so the mapping is inferred from the vendor's own ladder, not read

egress.terms: the shop advertises 'Download speed up to 300Mbps / Unlimited Traffic / Parallel downloads possible' per SKU; those are the vendor's features restated

limits.value: voucher must be converted at real-debrid.com/voucher with the reseller name selected
one holder per account; connections recorded

identity_cost.detail: PayPal, Visa/MasterCard, crypto and local payment methods, one-time payment, delivery by email; the buyer also needs a Real-Debrid account to redeem the voucher.

reliability_note: The voucher route is the least fragile resale form found: the account stays the buyer's and the seller never sees the password.

evidence.proved: the four prices, 'In stock' on each, the 'Official Reseller' header, and the redemption path at real-debrid.com/voucher
resale requires the vendor's explicit permission; voucher redemption is the sanctioned form of a third-party sale
the vendor baseline (EUR 4 / 30 days, EUR 9 / 90, EUR 16 / 180) that makes $8.90 a 1.9x markup
the shop accepts crypto and local methods besides cards
evidence.quote: Payment Flexibility: We accept local payment methods, Crypto and cards that international sites often reject.

evidence.proved: the page title lists PayPal and Visa/MasterCard
evidence.quote: Real Debrid Premium via Paypal, Visa/MasterCard | KeyOneClick Official Reseller

evidence.proved: one-time payment, instant delivery, four In stock price points
evidence.quote: Official Reseller - One Time Payment - Instant Delivery

evidence.proved: resale needs the vendor's explicit permission

notes: $17.50 for 90 days about 1.7x EUR 9. Every term is a markup, and the shop's own 'official' claim cannot be checked before purchase because the vendor's authorised-reseller list is served inside the logged-in interface.
